tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Brightest ground: the white end of the slide gradient and inner panels. Dark: raised navy panel and the navy end of the navy→teal gradient.

tokens.name: surface-050
tokens.usage: Default slide/page ground. Night (default): near-black navy (`ink` 16.5:1). Day: pale blue from your PPTX (`ink` 10.3:1).

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Ground for the light half of a split slide opposite `cobalt-600`. Dark: navy-teal.

tokens.name: sky-200
tokens.usage: Soft card fill for outlined 'research' cards; carries `title-accent` titles and `ink-strong` body (≥6:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: sky-300
tokens.usage: Title card and contents-pill fill; `ink` text on it (6.0:1 light, 8.4:1 dark). `indigo-500` titles on it only 24px+ in light.

tokens.name: sky-400
tokens.usage: Deep end of the signature gradient — sky in light, dark teal in dark. Never a text colour; `ink` reads on it (≥5.6:1).

tokens.name: periwinkle-300
tokens.usage: Side-navigation topic pills (inactive). `ink-strong` text on it (7.1:1 light, 10.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: indigo-500
tokens.usage: Primary brand hue. Light: indigo display titles (5.4:1 on `surface-050`) and solid Idea cards. Dark: deep teal fill for solid cards and the active pill, white text on it (5.5:1); as a title on navy, 24px+ only (3.3:1) — prefer `title-accent`.

tokens.name: navy-600
tokens.usage: Eyebrow-tag fill and the dark end of solid-card gradients; white text on it (7.7:1 light, 7.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: cobalt-600
tokens.usage: Bold block colour for split/illustrated slides (cobalt in light, deep teal-blue in dark); `on-block` text on it (≥5.5:1).

tokens.name: royal-700
tokens.usage: Bottom of image-caption fades and the dark end of spheres; white text on it (8.4:1 light, 18.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: bright-blue-400
tokens.usage: Illustration accent (molecules, rings) — blue in light, bright teal in dark. Decorative only, not for text.

tokens.name: coral-400
tokens.usage: Warm illustration accent paired with `bright-blue-400` (DNA, microscope, icons in white discs). Decorative only: 2.6:1 on white, never text or the only signal.

tokens.name: indigo-400
tokens.usage: Lighter start of the solid Idea-card gradient (top-left highlight); white text on it ≥4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: cobalt-500
tokens.usage: Lit top-left of a cobalt block's radial fill (NumberBadge stage). `on-block` text 24px+ on it.

tokens.name: title-accent
tokens.usage: Accent titles, eyebrows and secondary numbers: electric aqua at night (13.1:1 on `surface-050`, 7.2:1 on `sky-200`), navy by day (6.1:1 on `sky-200`).

tokens.name: on-block
tokens.usage: Text on `cobalt-600` blocks (5.5:1 light, 8.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: sphere-hi
tokens.usage: Highlight (top-left) of glossy number spheres.

tokens.name: sphere-base
tokens.usage: Body colour of glossy number spheres.

tokens.name: badge-ink
tokens.usage: Numeral on a sphere (≥3.3:1 light at 26px bold, 5.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: teal-400
tokens.usage: Teal accent for icons, chart highlights and the dark theme's glow. Decorative or 24px+ only on light grounds.

tokens.name: spark-400
tokens.usage: Electric-lime CONTRAST accent, used often but in small doses: numbering, rules under titles, buttons, chips, highlighter marks, progress bars, the hero stat. Text on dark grounds and dark fills (16.8:1 on the night ground; 4.2:1 on night `indigo-500` — 24px+ there). By day, never as text on light grounds — use `spark-ink`.

tokens.name: on-spark
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `spark-400` fills (14.3:1 light, 15.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: spark-ink
tokens.usage: Text-safe version of the contrast accent: deep lime-green on light grounds (6.2:1 on `surface-050`, 4.9:1 on `sky-200`); pure lime in dark.

tokens.name: capsule-shell
tokens.usage: White half of the 3D capsule motif (the other half is `spark-400` or `sky-300`). Decorative only.

tokens.name: sticker-fill
tokens.usage: Paper-white fill of playful sticker cards, bubbles and doodle discs — stays light even at night so stickers pop off the navy.

tokens.name: sticker-ink
tokens.usage: Outline and text colour on stickers and doodles (thick 3px cartoon line). 16:1 on `sticker-fill`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Default text: titles and body on `surface-050`, `surface-000`, `sky-200`, `sky-300`, `sky-400` — dark ink in light, pale ice in dark.

tokens.name: ink-deep
tokens.usage: Emphasis text and dark rules on light grounds.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Card outlines (4px) and bold labels on `sky-200`/`periwinkle-300`: near-black in light, near-white in dark.

tokens.name: slate-400
tokens.usage: Hairline rules, decorative strokes and soft dividers. Not for text.

tokens.name: uitm-purple
tokens.usage: UiTM logo ink — appears only inside the supplied logo files. Do not use as a UI colour.

tokens.name: uitm-navy
tokens.usage: UiTM logo ink (crest field). Logo-only.

tokens.name: uitm-gold
tokens.usage: UiTM logo ink (crest, 'di hatiku' tab). Logo-only.

tokens.name: drnam-green
tokens.usage: Chemistry with Dr. NAM logo ink (leaf/flask green). Logo-only — the system's accent stays `spark-400` lime.

tokens.name: drnam-navy
tokens.usage: Chemistry with Dr. NAM logo ink (banner navy). Logo-only; close to the Night ground, so the logo always sits on a white disc.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Frosted fill of a GlowPanel over the gradient ground or a photo. Text on it is `ink` (it sits over light grounds only).

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1.5px rim of glass panels and the top highlight of 3D surfaces.

tokens.name: glow-blue
tokens.usage: Halo colour behind glowing panels, active pills and key numbers. Light only — never text.

tokens.name: glow-white
tokens.usage: Inner highlight that makes clay-style 3D shapes look lit from above.

tokens.name: depth-shade
tokens.usage: Bottom inner shade of 3D shapes (from `royal-700`).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Cover and section-opener titles. Heavy, tight, big. Put 1–3 key words in a lime highlighter or lime text (night).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Slide titles, with a short `spark-400` rule (64×6px, pill) above or below.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card headings, topic pills, numbered list labels.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.sample: Exploring Molecular Reactions in Sustainable Environments
styles.usage: Subtitles under titles, presenter and institution lines.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: In silico tools bridge the gap, enabling rapid identification of promising candidates.
styles.usage: Slide body copy; left-aligned (avoid the source's full justification on narrow columns).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked lines of a card.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a title and the content below.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Slide safe margin (on a 1920×1080 slide).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Image frames inside cards, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Idea cards, image-caption cards, illustration panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large title cards and the main content panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Topic pills, eyebrow tags, number badges (fully rounded).

shadow.note: Light comes from the top-left. Every raised thing gets a contact shadow plus a soft spread; glow is reserved for the one thing to look at.

tokens.name: shadow-contact
tokens.usage: Tight shadow under small things: badges, tags, pills at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Soft lift under title cards and contents pills (Medicine deck).

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Layered 3D lift for cards and panels that sit above the slide: Idea cards, image cards, the main content panel.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Glowing halo for the ONE focus element per slide: a GlowPanel, the active topic pill, a key result. Blue in light, teal in dark.

tokens.name: shadow-spark
tokens.usage: Lime halo for a `spark-400` element that must pull the eye (a key stat, the CTA). Counts as the slide's one glow.

tokens.name: shadow-bevel
tokens.usage: Clay/3D bevel inside solid shapes (Idea cards, pills, badges): bright top rim, shaded bottom. Combine with `shadow-lift` or `shadow-contact`.

tokens.name: shadow-bevel-soft
tokens.usage: Gentler bevel for light fills (`sky-200`, `sky-300`, `periwinkle-300`).

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: Hard cartoon offset shadow (no blur) for playful stickers: ink by day, lime at night.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Flat outlined cards (Nature style) and anything on a photo.

tokens.name: stroke-card
tokens.usage: Outline width for 'research' cards, drawn in `ink-strong`.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Vertical divider between text columns, in `indigo-500`.

tokens.name: stroke-doodle
tokens.usage: Cartoon outline on stickers, bubbles and doodle icons, in `sticker-ink`.

effect.note: Filters and blur for glass and 3D shapes; pair with the shadow tokens.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur behind GlowPanels (use `blur(var(--blur-glass))`).

tokens.name: filter-lift
tokens.usage: Drop shadow for cut-out shapes and illustrations (3D capsules, PNG cut-outs, SVG blocks) — follows the shape's outline.

tokens.name: filter-glow
tokens.usage: Glow around a cut-out icon or molecule that is the focus of the slide.

interaction.note: Subtle hover and float for on-screen decks, web pages and kiosks. Static exports (PDF/PowerPoint) simply show the resting state. Respect prefers-reduced-motion: switch all of this off.

tokens.name: hover-lift
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles and pills rise this much on hover; their shadow steps up from `shadow-float`/`shadow-contact` to `shadow-lift`.

tokens.name: hover-tilt
tokens.usage: Maximum 3D tilt (rotateX/rotateY, perspective 900px) of a card following the pointer. Use on Idea cards, KeyStat tiles and GlowPanels only.

tokens.name: float-distance
tokens.usage: Idle 'hovering' bob of decorative 3D objects (capsules, orbs), up and down.

tokens.name: duration-hover
tokens.usage: Hover transitions.

tokens.name: duration-float
tokens.usage: One full idle float cycle — slow enough to feel alive, not busy.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Easing for every hover and reveal.

tokens.name: wiggle-angle
tokens.usage: Playful style only: stickers sit slightly tilted (±2–3°) and wiggle to straight on hover; doodles wobble this much.
